stories.title: A fire in a building in southern Thailand kills 11 people
stories.summary: BANGKOK (AP) — A fire burned through a building in southern Thailand early Monday, killing 11 people, authorities said. The fire started around 2 a.m.

stories.title: No podiums, but Canadians show some promise, potential at Skate America
stories.summary: EVERETT — Canadian skaters never reached the podium at Skate America's weekend competition, but most returned home satisfied they had made some progress in the fourth event of the ISU Figure Skating Grand Prix Series.

stories.title: Montreal Alouettes beaten in Grey Cup game a second straight year
stories.summary: CALGARY — The Montreal Alouettes' potent offence sputtered in the fourth quarter and the team went home from the Grey Cup empty-handed a second straight year.

stories.title: NHL roundup: McDavid matches Gretzky’s assist mark as Oilers beat Flyers
stories.summary: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Leon Draisaitl scored twice and Connor McDavid had a goal and two assists, in the process tying a 42-year-old NHL milestone set by Wayne Gretzky, as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-2 on Sunday night.

stories.title: Fajardo has two TD passes, runs for two more to power Elks past Alouettes in Grey Cup
stories.summary: CALGARY — Another Grey Cup win, another MVP title for Cody Fajardo. Fajardo threw two touchdown passes and ran for two more to power the Edmonton Elks past the Montreal Alouettes 37-30 on Sunday night.

stories.title: AAA forecasts another busy -- but not quite as busy -- Thanksgiving travel week
stories.summary: FORT COLLINS, Colo. (AP) — Pricey plane tickets and expensive gasoline are expected to keep some Americans from traveling this Thanksgiving, but not enough to make much difference in airport security lines and highway traffic, AAA said Monday.

stories.title: Chytil, Karlsson score twice as Canucks snap 7-game skid with 6-3 win over Golden Knights
stories.summary: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Filip Chytil and Linus Karlsson each scored twice and the Vancouver Canucks snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 6-3 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Sunday night.

stories.title: 'Doesn't mean anything to me': Alouettes’ Tyson Philpot top Canadian in Grey Cup loss
stories.summary: CALGARY — There was no consolation for Tyson Philpot after he was named the Grey Cup’s most valuable Canadian in a losing cause Sunday night.

stories.title: Canada exploring 'other options' with Europe, Asia to grow auto sector: Carney
stories.summary: PHNOM PENH — Prime Minister Mark Carney says the auto sector remains part of trade talks with the U.S., but that Canada is looking at "other options" in Europe and Asia.
